column1: # FIX-1187 — shared-CAND_ID merge manifest (shape A). THIS FILE IS AN AUTHORISATION.
# 151 (elected survivor, candidate stub) pairs that hold the SAME
# source_ids.fec_candidate_id and both hold money. Derived on the local prod-clone
# 2026-09-16; the population was re-derived READ-ONLY on prod the same day and is
# IDENTICAL (151 pairs, 151 distinct CAND_IDs, 151 distinct survivors, 151 distinct
# stubs — a clean 1:1:1). Every fact below is re-read keyed on (survivor, dup)
# inside the merge transaction by verifySharedIdInDb; a pair that has moved since
# is refused there and the run continues.
# Total stub money 2026-09-16: $926,589,966 across 99,217 rows. That figure
# reproduces the FIX-953 census of 2026-08-10 to the dollar, and the 2026
# fec_bulk_indiv slice (46,561 rows / $72,951,060 on 88 stubs) reproduces cc-126's
# prod measurement to the row. Every stub row was last written between 2026-05-13
# and 2026-07-28 and none since: these are frozen July snapshots left behind when
# FIX-941 handed the shared binding to the elected rows.
# IDENTITY IS THE CAND_ID, NOT THE SEAT. old_seat_verdict records what the FIX-953
# own-seat gate WOULD have said, so the 117 pass / 29 fail-district / 5 fail-office
# split stays visible — but the shared-id path deliberately does not apply it. The
# 34 refusals are exactly the cases where the id's encoded seat lags the person's
# current seat (redistricting; a House->Senate move), which is not evidence about
# identity for a pair selected by id equality.
# ATTACHMENTS ARE ZERO ON ALL 151, measured on BOTH clone and prod 2026-09-16
# comments, civic responses, lobbying, sponsored bills, proposal actions,
# external_relationships). FIX-1020's class is empty in this population.
# READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING — the collision tie-break. The design premised that
# the survivor's row is always the fresher one. IT IS NOT: on prod only 58,568 of
# 99,217 collisions (59.0%) are survivor-fresher, because updated_at moves only
# when a row's VALUE changes, so a row that is still correct keeps an old stamp.
# What IS true, measured on prod 2026-09-16 and on the clone, is strictly
# stronger for money: in EVERY cell, the count of collisions where the amounts
# DIFFER and the dup is fresher is ZERO. Where the two rows disagree on amount
# (8,456 rows on prod) the survivor is always the fresher one and already wins;
# where the dup wins the tie-break (40,649 rows) the amounts are identical and
# the outcome is the same either way. The existing keep-the-fresher rule is
# therefore money-safe here, but it is safe for a different reason than the one
# written down, and the >=99%-survivor-fresher gate in cc-128 does NOT pass.
# cc-129 must re-measure `diff_and_dup_fresher = 0` on prod immediately before
# applying and stop if it is not zero.
# stub_cents is the stub's FULL holding across all cycles and relationship types.
# (relationship_type, from_id, cycle_year) against the survivor, the same key as
# financial_relationships_relcycle_unique. Ordered by stub_cents descending, which
# is the order cc-129's sets are cut in.
